mapper.update: UPDATE arte_ai_account SET snapshot=#{snapshot} WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
UPDATE arte_ai_reservation SET snapshot=#{snapshot} WHERE id_key=#{idKey}
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot FROM arte_ai_reservation WHERE attempt_key=#{attemptKey} AND invocation_key=#{invocationKey}
SELECT digest,result_snapshot FROM arte_ai_settlement WHERE reservation_key=#{reservationKey} AND settlement_key=#{settlementKey}
SELECT snapshot FROM arte_ai_account WHERE id_key=#{idKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT snapshot FROM arte_ai_reservation WHERE id_key=#{idKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: FROM arte_ai_reservation r JOIN arte_ai_account a ON a.id_key=r.account_key JOIN arte_ai_invocation i ON i.id_key=r.invocation_key WHERE r.account_key=#{accountKey} AND a.owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND i.owner_key=#{ownerKey} AND (r.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"RESERVED"%' OR r.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"PENDING_RECONCILIATION"%') AND i.snapshot LIKE '%"kind":"GENERATION"%' AND (i.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"UNKNOWN"%' OR i.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"SUCCEEDED"%' OR i.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"FAILED"%' OR i.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"CANCELLED"%' OR i.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"TIMED_OUT"%' OR i.snapshot LIKE '%"state":"INTERRUPTED"%')
mapper.select:
SELECT r.snapshot
ORDER BY r.id_key ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
